messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — spike in 5xx rate for hosted-inference (api.redwood-prod) across eu-west. Rolling pages to primary/secondary.

sam_b: grabbing it as primary. joining the bridge.

raj_p: i'm secondary. ping me if sam needs unblocked.

liz: oncall FYI — we're seeing ~6.2% 5xx over a 5m window, normal is <0.5%. Traffic looks normal. No deploys in last 30m.

marta: :eyes: thanks. what's the blast radius? Any customer-visible failures reported?

sam_b: customer-facing: a handful of streaming requests got truncated, some completions returned 500. CS reported 3 tickets, small accounts. Bulk traffic hitting models with long prefixes.

ops-bot: runbook link: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/serve-5xx — steps 1-4 recommended. Also recommended temp alert tuning snippet below.

sam_b: quick plan: 1) increase alert thresholds to avoid pager storm while we mitigate (2h), 2) enable KV cache for long-prefix model group, 3) roll a hotfix to runtime kernel with mem-fix fallback.

liz: agree. For alerting: set paging to SEV2 for the next 2 hours, suppress repetitive pages if same source for 10m. We should still track metrics and alert to perf-channel.

raj_p: i'll make the change in monitoring. command:
```
# Temporarily raise 5xx alert threshold and change pager level
monitoring update-alert \
  --service hosted-inference \
  --metric http_5xx_rate \
  --alert_threshold 0.07 \
  --pager_level SEV2 \
  --snooze_duration 120m
```

marta: try to keep threshold no higher than the point where real user impact hides. 7% ok for now. document the change and who authorized.

sam_b: authorized by on-call (sam_b) + SRE lead (marta). I'll add a short note to the incident thread and notify CS.

cs-notify-bot: @cs-team Heads up: small subset of customers may see degraded completions. CS has 3 open tickets. Please use internal status template if asked.

liz: when we flip the pager level, also add a short-term alert to perf-channel with the reason and revert time (120m). who will monitor fallbacks after hotfix?

raj_p: i'll watch logs and KV metrics. sam, if hotfix fails we fallback to model-variant routing to lower mem profile.

sam_b: on it. taking first actions now: enabling KV cache group a, applying soft threshold change. I'll paste update when done.

sam_b: applied KV cache toggle and pushed monitoring update. Pager level now SEV2 for 120m. :thumbsup:

marta: good. please add a one-line entry to the SLO-change log with timestamp and decision rationale.

sam_b: done. log entry: "2024-03-xxTxx:xxZ — Temp alert threshold raised to 7% and pager set to SEV2 for 120m to reduce noise during mitigation. Authorized by sam_b, marta."

ops-bot: reminder: once traffic normalizes, revert the alert config. Use:
```
monitoring revert-alert --service hosted-inference --metric http_5xx_rate
```

raj_p: metrics trending down: 5xx at 2.1% over last 5m. continuing to monitor.

liz: nice. once below 0.5% for 10m, we revert and close this thread. CS flagged to update customers if more tickets appear.

sam_b: closing loop: hotfix deployed (runtime mem guard), KV cache reduced tail-latency. Will stay on watch for 30m then handoff to next shift.

marta: great job. Please ensure playbook is updated with the model-variant routing note (step 5) so next time it's faster.

sam_b: noted. handing off primary to raj_p in 35m. secondary to liz. leaving notes in rotation doc.

raj_p: acknowledged. thanks everyone.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — 5xx spike mitigated. Final metrics: peak 6.9% -> stabilized 0.3%. No major customer outages. Thread closed after handoff.
